name: UTKARSH KHASGIWALE
tagline: Front-end focused developer with hands-on experience building responsive, animation-rich web interfaces using React, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, and Vite, alongside a strong foundation in C++, Python, Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, and MySQL. Comfortable owning a UI end-to-end — from component architecture and state management to motion design and performance — and equally capable contributing to Python-based backend and automation tooling. Looking for an entry-level developer role to build reliable, user-friendly, cross-platform front-end products.

projects.name: Ember Studio
projects.description: Architected the front-end component structure of a multi-page agency website, including routing, shared application state, and a reusable navigation system. Built a custom motion and interaction layer with GSAP, including a hand-built animated cursor component, to deliver a refined, production-grade user experience. Defined and implemented a cohesive visual design system on top of Tailwind CSS, balancing aesthetic polish with performance across devices.

projects.name: RestaurantAI
projects.description: Built a conversational restaurant ordering and kitchen-management agent using LangGraph and FastAPI. Implemented the complete order lifecycle from Take Order → Cook → Serve → Bill → Paid, with per-item cart status and partial success/failure handling. Separated LLM language understanding from deterministic business logic for inventory, pricing, tax, and ETA. Added tiered failure recovery with bounded retries, substitution suggestions, targeted recooking, and human escalation.
